title: Traverse document differences once and sort only changed branches
body:
## Problem
Document diffs compare entire nested dictionaries before visiting them again, and sort every field name even for sparse edits.

## Change
Traverse matching members once, recurse directly and sort only changed branches. Preserve exact depth-first order and text; scan added keys only when needed.

## Validation
Native macOS / Xcode 27.1 / Swift 6.4: 10 fixture outputs match the original exactly, separately with upstream and optimized comparison cores. Each workload has 15 samples per variant across 3 alternating processes; 12 diffs per sample, or 4 for deep nesting. Upstream medians: 15,000 fields with one edit, 1.68726 to 0.53067 s (3.179x); 2,500 fields nested 24 levels, 0.60238 to 0.02283 s (26.386x); all 2,000 fields changed, 0.25405 to 0.19428 s; 15,000 unchanged fields, 0.66569 to 0.49540 s. With comparison optimization: sparse 3.258x, deep 29.273x, dense 1.611x and unchanged 1.355x. All predeclared gates pass. Dense peak RSS increases 160 KiB; these are fixture-level timings.
11 existing native executables and the app/share simulator build pass. Swift source and test blobs match validation. A same-branch follow-up fixes the helper default from all to correctness. Its actual default CLI passes all 10 output fixtures in https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43228714033, which also passes all 10 new and 23 existing native executables and the app/share build. Real methods are extracted verbatim; no physical-device or UI validation is claimed.
https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43226576742
Reproduce: python3 tests/run_document_diff_regression.py --test tests/DocumentDiffTests.swift

## Related work
Checked 45 all-state upstream PRs, 30 own prior PRs, 54 current fork heads and 79 issues. The old integration retains repeated traversal. Independent of exact-value comparison, field-search caching and field-edit semantics; validated with both comparison versions.

title: Reduce allocations in exact plist comparisons
body:
## Problem
Typed plist comparison creates two key sets per dictionary and decimal strings for every integer pair. Large documents repeatedly pay this cost during diffs, read-back and ownership checks.

## Change
Check dictionary counts before the existing key/value traversal. Use exact NSNumber ordering for integers after the strict type check, retaining BOOL/float separation and UInt64 correctness.

## Validation
Original and revised sources both pass 8 dictionary cases and 176,400 signed/unsigned boundary and random pairs, including UInt64.max versus -1 and 2^53 neighbors. Native macOS / Xcode 27.1 / Swift 6.4; 15 alternating samples per variant, 12 public matches calls per sample: wide median 0.769932292 to 0.338718625 s (2.273x); nested 0.585064042 to 0.262104458 s (2.232x). Peak RSS is essentially unchanged; these are fixture-level timings.
Benchmarks and 12 existing native tests passed in https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43224939964 before a validation-only missing-dependency failure. Identical source blobs were checked in https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43225587185, which passed the remaining 5 tests and the app/share simulator build. Published blobs match validation. An earlier count-only experiment failed the performance threshold and was discarded. No physical-device or UI validation is claimed.

## Related work
Checked 45 upstream PRs, 30 own prior PRs, 43 prior fork heads plus new batch branches, and 79 issues. #31 fixed int64Value wraparound; this preserves it with exact comparison and boundary coverage. Separate from cache scanning and field-search optimizations.

title: Preserve existing plist keys when editing field values
body:
## Problem
Editing an existing plist key silently trims its whitespace, can rename it or collide with a distinct neighbor, and rejects whitespace-only/empty existing keys.

## Change
Keep unchanged existing keys exact. Preserve trimming and blank/collision validation for new names and intentional renames.

## Validation
Native macOS/Xcode27.1/Swift6.4: untouched upstream 5 assertion failures and 4 controls; fix passes 9 cases and binary roundtrips, 11 existing executables, and actual app/share-extension simulator build. Real manager methods are extracted verbatim into a Foundation harness. Production/test blobs match validation. No physical-device or UI interaction claim.
https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43223015927

## Related work
45 upstream PRs, 30 own prior PRs, 43 old fork heads/new batch branches and 79 issues checked. Old integration still trims keys. Distinct from #34 value precision and pending-preset overwrite handling.

title: Preserve explicit field edits over conflicting layout presets
body:
## Problem
Pending Dynamic Island layouts overwrite explicit MG Control flag edits/deletions/renames; restore/remove presets can overwrite explicit artwork edits.

## Change
Clear only conflicting layout choices when their output fields are edited. Preserve flag-only Enable and independent presets.

## Validation
Native macOS/Xcode27.1/Swift6.4: unchanged upstream 6 assertion failures and 4 passing controls; fix passes 10 new cases and 11 existing executables. Actual app/share-extension simulator build passes. Tests extract real manager methods verbatim into a Foundation state holder; no physical-device/UI interaction claim. Production/test blobs match validation.
https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43222488378

## Related work
45 upstream PRs, 30 own prior PRs, 43 fork heads and 79 issues checked. Distinct from #34 value precision, #37 backup guards, #38 malformed artwork and #58 applied-layout restoration.

title: Reuse one preview snapshot when searching field values
body:
## Problem and change

MG Control rebuilds the staged document preview for every value searched. Reuse `preview.extra` once per synchronous filter, preserving sorted/localized matching and plist display formats. Row text and edits still read current values; no persistent cache is introduced.

## Verification

[Native run](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43223734185): 18 behavior cases pass on both base and revised code; all seven benchmark workloads return identical keys. Xcode 27.1 / Swift 6.4 app and share-extension Simulator builds pass.

Nine-sample median times for an unmatched query with a staged name preset: 512 original fields 408.33→2.96 ms (IQR 366.15–450.02→2.92–3.00), 2048 fields 6738.79→16.37 ms. Empty-query control: 1.53→1.62 ms.

The runner compiles exact search/preview methods with real document/preset/formatting code. Measurements cover this computation, not SwiftUI rendering or physical-device latency; timing is not a test threshold.

title: Reduce cache descriptor string-scan allocations
body:
## Change

Scan cache string tables within Data.withUnsafeBytes using bounded NUL searches; replace unnecessary per-hash Strings with target-key classifications. Preserve UUID/layout/type/ambiguity checks.

## Validation

Native public-scanner, malformed-descriptor and document tests pass; app/share simulator build passes. Five alternating benchmark rounds: typical 0.417 to 0.314ms; 200000 strings 35.69 to 18.04ms and peak RSS58.61 to25.40MB; long-token workload3.404 to0.530ms. Synthetic hosted-macOS workloads; no device latency claim.

Evidence: https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43223528088

title: Validate backup metadata filenames against record IDs
body:
## Problem and change

Require backup metadata filename UUIDs to match record IDs, preventing aliases and duplicate history entries. Preserve lowercase filenames and legacy records; leave invalid files untouched.

## Validation

Native macOS: original 3 behavior failures; revised all 6 cases pass. Twelve existing native document/backup programs and app/share simulator build pass. Physical-device/full UI tests unrun.

Evidence: https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43222231356

title: Fix sharing when the first signed inbox is unavailable
body:
## Problem and change

Try signed App Group inboxes in order when publishing a MobileGestalt plist, stopping after the first atomic success. Preserve cancellation, containment and the first error if all fail; never duplicate a completed share.

Merged current `main` (`c60519c6`) and adapted the fallback to the provider callback's `save` path. The receipt records the inbox that actually accepted the plist, so cancellation cleans up that handoff. Wallpaper publication keeps its existing separate queue and path.

## Validation

Native macOS with Xcode 27.1 / Swift 6.4:

- Current upstream: 4 expected fallback failures and 8 passing controls.
- Revised code: all 12 cases passed, including provider cancellation, cleanup after fallback, and a wallpaper queue control.
- All 5 existing suites passed: `SharedPlistInboxTests`, `SharedInboxContainmentTests`, `SharedInboxCleanupTests`, `SharedMetadataNameTests`, and `ItemProviderLoadTests`.
- The app and share extension simulator build passed.

Evidence: https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43362409400

The source and test files in validation commit `66c343df` are byte-for-byte identical to PR commit `1b11f0ec`; the validation branch additionally contains its workflow. No physical-device or full UIKit test.

The upstream [Build IPA](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/actions/runs/43362706202) also passed on `1b11f0ec`.

title: Reject trailing text in date field values
body:
## Problem and change
ISO8601DateFormatter silently accepts a valid date prefix followed by junk or a second date. Require the complete timestamp before parsing, retaining fractions, time zones, outer whitespace and the existing error message.

## Validation
Native macOS/Xcode 27.1/Swift 6.4: both new trailing-input tests fail against original 6a8f94d and pass with the fix; valid-input controls and nine existing regression executables pass. App/share extension build for iOS simulator; diff check passes. Production/test blobs match this successful run; no physical-device execution.
CI: https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43213528175

All-state upstream/own PRs and branches checked. #34 preserves unchanged field precision and does not validate newly entered complete date text.

title: Compare cache UUIDs consistently across restores and original-value history
body:
## Problem and change
The layout resolver accepts UUID case differences, but original-value journals and restore checks reject the same identifiers. Compare UUIDs case-insensitively across these paths while preserving stored spelling and existing version/length/device/history checks.

## Validation
Native macOS/Xcode 27.1/Swift 6.4: identical new tests against original 6a8f94d fail all three scenarios; revised originals/restore/history tests pass. Eight existing native regression executables pass. App/share extension build for iOS simulator; diff check passes. Validated production/test blobs match this commit. No physical-device execution.
CI: https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/43211885621

All 45 upstream PRs, my 30 prior merged PRs, issues and fork branches checked; prior generation/history fixes do not handle these comparisons.

title: Please add support iOS 18.7.11
body:
Feature Request: Add support for iOS 18.7.11 (A12 devices)

Summary

I would like to request compatibility with iOS 18.7.11, particularly on A12 devices such as the iPhone XS Max.

Currently, GestaltX targets iOS/iPadOS 27.x, while earlier iOS versions are not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access.

Device information

* Device: iPhone XS Max
* Device Identifier: iPhone11,6
* Chip: Apple A12 Bionic
* iOS Version: 18.7.11

Requested features

1. Investigate the feasibility of supporting on-device MobileGestalt access on iOS 18.7.11.
2. Explore an alternative access method or compatibility layer for older iOS versions.
3. Support reading, editing, backing up, and restoring MobileGestalt data.
4. Preserve existing functionality on supported iOS 27.x devices.

Technical considerations

I understand that the current worse_query implementation may depend on APIs or system behavior specific to iOS 27.x.

Rather than simply extending the version check, would it be possible to investigate an alternative implementation for iOS 18, potentially using a different access mechanism?

Motivation

Many legacy devices, especially A12-based iPhones, are still perfectly usable and have considerable hardware capabilities.

Bringing GestaltX to older iOS versions would make its MobileGestalt customization features accessible to a much wider range of devices.

I would be happy to help test compatibility on an iPhone XS Max running iOS 18.7.11.

Thank you for your work on GestaltX!

title: iPhone 13 Pro Display Scaling Issue: Abnormal Zoom Behavior After Using GestaltX
body: 设备与系统信息 - 设备： iPhone 13 Pro - iOS 版本： iOS 27.0.1 - GestaltX 版本： 1.0.5 问题描述 我最初使用 GestaltX 开启了灵动岛功能，之后才进入「设置 → 外观 → 显示缩放」修改显示缩放设置。 选择「更大文字」，点击右上角的勾并确认「使用放大模式」后，应用后界面仍保持默认大小，没有应用放大效果。 但是，随后通过其他方式重启 iPhone，例如使用快捷指令重启、手动关机再开机，或按键强制重启后，整个界面就会异常变大，包括桌面图标、文字和设置界面。 异常状态下，界面内容仍然完整，没有被屏幕边缘裁切，但整体显示尺寸明显变大。 值得注意的是，即使关闭 GestaltX 的灵动岛功能，再次切换显示缩放，仍然会出现完全相同的问题。 复现步骤 1. 使用 GestaltX 开启灵动岛功能。 2. 进入「设置 → 外观 → 显示缩放」。 3. 选择「更大文字」。 4. 点击右上角的勾，并确认「使用放大模式」。 5. 应用后，界面仍保持默认大小，没有应用放大效果。 6. 随后使用快捷指令重启、手动关机再开机，或按键强制重启 iPhone。 7. 重启后，整个系统界面异常变大。 异常表现 - 选择「更大文字」并确认后，界面没有立即变大。 - 随后通过其他方式重启，界面才会异常变大。 - 再次进入显示缩放设置时，仍然显示「默认」处于选中状态。 - 辅助功能中的「缩放」已关闭。 - 异常时桌面图标、文字和设置界面都会整体变大，但内容没有被裁切。 - 关闭 GestaltX 的灵动岛功能后，再次切换显示缩放，问题仍然会复现。 已尝试的排查方法 - 最初先使用 GestaltX 开启灵动岛功能，之后修改 iOS 显示缩放设置，出现上述问题。 - 关闭 GestaltX 的灵动岛功能后，再次切换显示缩放，仍然出现完全相同的问题。 - 恢复开启灵动岛之前保存的 GestaltX 完整备份，问题仍然存在。 - 执行 iPhone「还原所有设置」后，显示暂时恢复正常。 - 不再修改显示缩放，直接重启，界面可以保持正常。 - 再次选择「更大文字」后，问题又会复现。 - 确认辅助功能中的「缩放」处于关闭状态。 - 确认设备运行的是正式版 iOS 27.0.1，没有安装测试版描述文件。 截图分辨率 - 正常默认显示：1170 × 2532 - 异常放大显示：960 × 2079 希望协助确认 问题最初是在开启 GestaltX 灵动岛功能后出现的，但关闭灵动岛功能后，再次切换显示缩放仍然会复现。 想确认 GestaltX 是否曾修改或影响 iOS 的显示缩放及相关系统配置，以及这些配置是否可能在关闭灵动岛功能后仍然保留，从而导致显示缩放状态异常。 --- English iPhone 13 Pro Display Scaling Issue: Abnormal Zoom Behavior After Using GestaltX Device and System Information - Device: iPhone 13 Pro - iOS Version: iOS 27.0.1 - GestaltX Version: 1.0.5 Description I initially enabled the Dynamic Island feature using GestaltX. Only after enabling it did I go to Settings → Appearance → Display Zoom to change the display scaling setting. I selected “Larger Text,” tapped the checkmark in the upper-right corner, and confirmed “Use Zoomed View.” However, after applying the setting, the interface remained at the default size instead of applying the zoomed view. However, after subsequently restarting the iPhone through other methods, such as using a Shortcut, shutting down and turning the device back on, or performing a button-based force restart, the entire interface became unusually enlarged. This affects the Home Screen icons, text, and Settings interface. In the enlarged state, all interface content remains visible and is not clipped by the screen edges, but everything is noticeably larger. Importantly, even after disabling the Dynamic Island feature in GestaltX, changing Display Zoom again reproduces the exact same issue. Steps to Reproduce 1. Enable the Dynamic Island feature using GestaltX. 2. Open Settings → Appearance → Display Zoom. 3. Select “Larger Text.” 4. Tap the checkmark in the upper-right corner and confirm “Use Zoomed View.” 5. After applying the setting, the interface remains at its default size instead of applying the zoomed view. 6. Subsequently restart the iPhone using a Shortcut, shut it down and turn it back on, or perform a button-based force restart. 7. After restarting, the entire system interface becomes unusually enlarged. Observed Behavior - After selecting “Larger Text” and confirming the setting, the interface does not immediately become larger. - The interface only becomes unusually enlarged after a subsequent restart using another method. - When I revisit Display Zoom settings, “Default” is still selected. - Accessibility Zoom is turned off. - Home Screen icons, text, and the Settings interface are all enlarged, but the content is not clipped. - Disabling the Dynamic Island feature in GestaltX does not resolve the issue. Changing Display Zoom again reproduces the same behavior. Troubleshooting Already Tried - Initially enabled the Dynamic Island feature using GestaltX, then changed the iOS Display Zoom setting, which led to the issue. - Disabled the Dynamic Island feature in GestaltX and tried changing Display Zoom again. The exact same issue still occurred. - Restored the complete GestaltX backup created before enabling the Dynamic Island feature, but the issue persisted. - Used Reset All Settings on the iPhone, which temporarily restored normal display behavior. - Restarted the iPhone without changing Display Zoom settings, and the interface remained normal. - Selected “Larger Text” again, and the issue reappeared. - Confirmed that Accessibility Zoom is turned off. - Confirmed that the device is running the public release of iOS 27.0.1 and has no beta profile installed. Screenshot Resolutions - Normal default display: 1170 × 2532 - Abnormally enlarged display: 960 × 2079 What I Would Like to Know The issue initially appeared after enabling the Dynamic Island feature through GestaltX. However, disabling the Dynamic Island feature does not resolve the issue. Changing Display Zoom still reproduces the exact same behavior. Could GestaltX have modified or affected iOS Display Zoom or related system configurations? Could such changes persist even after disabling the Dynamic Island feature, potentially causing the display scaling issue? I would appreciate help investigating whether GestaltX could be related to this behavior.

title: [讨论] 国行设备已激活新版 Siri 玻璃球，但 AI 服务仍提示地区不支持
body:
**Siri AI 玻璃球界面的激活与 Apple Intelligence、ChatGPT Extension 的地区授权采用独立的判断机制。**
该工具目前来看几乎已经可以解锁 Siri AI 在大陆的真实外版设备体验：正常显示 Siri AI 的玻璃球界面，但没法实际使用（意料之中）。
没有测试 eSIM 的相关功能。

## 1. 测试设备

| 设备 | 销售地区 | 系统版本 | 测试方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| iPhone 17 Pro Max | 香港 | iOS 27.3 Beta 1 | 原生设备，未使用 GestaltX 或其他工具修改 MobileGestalt，作为在中国大陆使用外版设备的对照组 |
| iPad Pro M4 | 中国大陆 | iPadOS 27.3 Beta 1 | 使用 GestaltX 进行功能测试 |

## 2. Siri 界面的变化

调整设置的整个过程中，在设置界面共观察到了四种不同的 Siri 图标：

| 阶段 | 图标外观 | 设置中的功能名称 | 表现 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 传统 Siri 图标 | Siri | 原版国行 Siri 界面 |
| 2 | iOS 26 彩色图标 | Siri and Apple Intelligence | 传统新版 Siri 跑马灯界面 |
| 3 | 八角星 Logo | Siri and Apple Intelligence | 仍为传统新版 Siri 跑马灯界面 |
| 4 | 圆形玻璃球图标 | Siri | 新版 Siri AI 界面，可以正常触发玻璃球发光动画 |

第四种状态通过以下配置实现：
- 修改 Sales Region 和 Region Code。
- 开启 Apple Intelligence Capability。
- 保持 On-Device Siri 以及它以下的所有功能不变。[#98](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/issues/98) 中报告了开启 On-Device Siri 导致出现跑马灯的旧版 Siri 的问题。
- 重新启动设备。

## 3. 账户及系统配置

相关设置均已调整为美国英语：

- iCloud、App Store：美国区账户。
- 系统国家和地区：美国。
- 系统语言、Siri 语言：English (US)。
- 网络：美国全局 VPN。

虽然已经能够正常显示玻璃球版本的 Siri AI ，但仍无法使用，ChatGPT Extensions 也提示当前地区不受支持。

## 4. 港版 iPhone 与国行 iPad 对照测试

### 港版 iPhone 17 Pro Max

原生设备，未修改 MobileGestalt，使用美区 iCloud 账户，账户地区、系统地区和语言均设置为美国英语。

| 使用环境 | Siri AI |
|---|---|
| 中国大陆 + +86 实体 SIM 卡 | 无法使用 |
| 中国大陆 + 拔掉 +86 实体 SIM 卡 + 美国全局 VPN | 可以使用 |
| 前往国外 + 拔掉 +86 实体 SIM 卡 | 可以使用 |

### 国行 iPad Pro M4 无蜂窝网络版本

使用 GestaltX 修改相关配置，使用美区 iCloud 和 App Store，系统地区及语言均设置为美国英语。

即使开启美国全局 VPN，Siri AI 和 ChatGPT Extensions 依然提示当前地区不受支持。

## 5. 让我疑惑的问题

1. 为什么原生港版 iPhone 拔卡并使用美国 VPN 就能正常使用 AI，而国行 iPad 在无 SIM 卡的情况下仍然无法使用？
2. Apple 是否还会根据其他设备标识判断 Apple Intelligence 的服务可用性？

title: Add iPhone Air model presets
body:
## What this adds

Four iPhone Air variants to the **Model Number** picker, transcribed from Apple's "Identify your iPhone model" article (<https://support.apple.com/108044>):

| Model | Region |
|---|---|
| **A3260** | United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Bahrain, Guam, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, U.S. Virgin Islands |
| **A3516** | Japan |
| **A3517** | Other countries and regions |
| **A3518** | China mainland |

One detail worth calling out: **iPhone Air shares A3260 between the United States and Canada**, unlike iPhone 18 Pro where Canada shares A3713 with Japan. So the label reads `United States / Canada` rather than assuming a dedicated Canadian number the way the 18 Pro rows do.

## Also changed

- **Footer text.** It previously stated that the listed values apply only to iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. It now includes iPhone Air, since the list covers three models.
- **Localization.** The four new titles and the revised footer are added to the `TRANSLATIONS` table and to all six `localization/*.json` files, and `GestaltX/Localizable.xcstrings` was regenerated with `scripts/generate_localization.py`.

  Before editing anything I ran the generator against the committed tree and confirmed it reproduces `Localizable.xcstrings` byte-for-byte, so the 226-line diff is only the new strings and the reworded footer, not a re-serialization.

## Testing

- `xcodebuild -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release` succeeds with the new entries.
- **Not tested on an iPhone Air** — I don't own one. The model numbers are transcribed from Apple's page, not observed on a device.

## Please double-check the translations

The Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/Hong Kong) entries follow the existing terminology in each file (`美國／加拿大`, `中國大陸` and so on). The Korean, Russian, Vietnamese and Persian strings are mine, built from the phrasing already used for the A3716 / A3718 rows — **they would benefit from a native review** before release. If you would rather handle them yourself, drop the `localization/*.json` changes and the generator run from this PR and keep only the Swift change; the new labels will fall back to English until localized.

title: fix: clean abandoned shared imports without interrupting writers
body:
## Problem

Interrupted publications and rejected documents remain hidden in the App Group indefinitely. Each can retain a plist of up to 16 MB after leaving the import queue.

## Change

Remove recognized pending folders older than 24 hours and rejected folders older than seven days, with at most 32 removals per pass. Preserve published entries, recent folders, and unknown names. Hold a writer lease through publication; cleanup attempts the lease without waiting and skips active writers. Use descriptor-relative cleanup that does not follow links, with best-effort maintenance failures.

## Validation

`SharedInboxCleanupTests.swift` starts a separate process holding a real writer lease, verifies prompt cleanup and preservation of the active folder, then checks removal after release. It also covers recent rejection timestamps, old published entries, unknown names, symlinks, a FIFO lease, and failed maintenance paths.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch and combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291), job `clean-abandoned-shared-files`.

title: fix: keep coordinated plist reads off the main actor
body:
## Problem

Import preparation performs synchronous file coordination and disk reads on GestaltManager's main actor. A slow File Provider or file presenter can freeze the interface while the app waits.

## Change

Run coordinated and inbox reads in background tasks. Hold security-scoped access until reading finishes and consume temporary URLs within the coordinator accessor. Forward cancellation to the worker and coordinator, check it after suspended verification, and retain cancelled shared imports.

## Validation

`SharedImportWorkerTests.swift` checks main-queue progress during coordination, temporary accessor-URL lifetime, cancellation before startup and during a wait, and queue reads that preserve their entry until acknowledgement.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428), job `read-shared-imports-off-main`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: retain shared imports after temporary access failures
body:
## Problem

Shared-import preparation quarantines valid documents when filesystem access, file coordination, or the device-proof Keychain is temporarily unavailable. Only one identity error previously permitted retry.

## Change

Preserve filesystem error codes and classify specific permission, locking, interruption, resource, cancellation, and Keychain availability failures as retryable. Retain queued bytes for a later retry. Invalid content, missing/invalid proofs, identity mismatches, and unknown failures leave the automatic queue. Add the temporary-proof message to all eight locales and generation sources.

## Validation

`SharedImportRecoveryTests.swift` exercises real queued files with temporary and permanent errors, wrapped underlying errors, cancellation, later successful reads, and an out-of-range NSError code.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch and combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291), job `retry-temporary-shared-imports`.

title: fix: keep shared filenames within the metadata read budget
body:
## Problem

Suggested filenames are limited to 200 characters, but entry.json is limited to 4,096 bytes when read. Composed Unicode characters can consume many bytes, so a share can publish successfully and then disappear from inbox enumeration.

## Change

Apply a 1,024-byte UTF-8 name budget without splitting grapheme clusters. Retain the character and control-character limits, verify encoded metadata size before publication, and share one metadata limit between writing and reading.

## Validation

`SharedMetadataNameTests.swift` covers long emoji names, a very large combining-character cluster, JSON escaping, path/control-character sanitization, and ordinary filenames. Accepted entries remain discoverable and preserve the plist bytes.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783243933), job `bound-shared-metadata-names`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: confine shared inbox operations to their container
body:
## Problem

The inbox validates batch and document links but follows ancestor directories such as GestaltX, ShareInbox, and the app namespace. Replacing an ancestor with a link can redirect publishing, reading, or cleanup into another namespace.

## Change

Walk from the App Group container using directory descriptors and O_NOFOLLOW. Publish, enumerate, read, quarantine, and remove batches relative to those descriptors. External File Provider reads remain coordinated; published local copies use bounded descriptor reads.

## Validation

`SharedInboxContainmentTests.swift` checks links at all three ancestor levels, protects an independent namespace through every inbox operation, and checks normal handoff and nested-link cleanup while preserving the external target.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783243933), job `confine-shared-inbox-paths`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: isolate failures between shared import inboxes
body:
## Problem

One unreadable App Group inbox aborts the entire shared-import snapshot, hiding valid documents delivered to another signed group.

## Change

Collect readable entries from each inbox independently. If no readable entries remain, report the first enumeration error so inaccessible storage remains distinguishable from an empty queue. Preserve deterministic ordering.

## Validation

`SharedInboxIsolationTests.swift` covers a malformed inbox beside a healthy group in either order, preservation of the damaged path, errors after healthy entries are consumed, and empty or missing inboxes.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783243933), job `isolate-shared-inboxes`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: keep failed backup deletions recoverable and retryable
body:
## Problem

Deleting listing metadata before the payload hides a recoverable backup if payload removal fails. Deleting the payload first also needs a retry path when metadata removal subsequently fails.

## Change

Delete the payload before its metadata, preserving the complete visible backup when payload removal is denied. On retry, the precise missing-file error permits metadata cleanup to continue; other deletion errors propagate.

## Validation

`BackupDeletionTests.swift` injects failures around real temporary files. It checks denied payload deletion with intact metadata/readable data, successful retry without residue, and metadata failure followed by cleanup despite the already-removed payload.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428), job `preserve-backup-on-delete-failure`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: avoid device writes for unchanged backup restores
body:
## Problem

Restoring a backup or verified import that already matches the device still rewrites the system file, creates duplicate backups, and requests a restart.

## Change

After ownership/layout checks and a live-byte freshness check, return the existing snapshot when restored values already match. Preserve the current encoding and skip duplicate backup/journal creation. Genuine changes and explicit original-absence corrections continue through the write path.

## Validation

`UnchangedRestoreTests.swift` uses XML live files and binary equivalents to check exact byte preservation, writer/access counts, backup/journal side effects, verified imports, stale snapshots, foreign metadata, origin corrections, and real writes. The new message is maintained in all localization sources.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch and combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291), job `skip-unchanged-device-restores`.

title: fix: compare valid NaN property-list values consistently
body:
## Problem

Foundation accepts NaN as a plist real and preserves it through binary serialization. Floating-point arithmetic equality makes such a document unequal to itself, so unrelated edits fail full readback verification and device-bound exports reject their own signed payloads.

## Change

Treat two NaNs as the same stored real value after confirming matching plist kinds. Keep finite values, positive infinity, negative infinity, and other plist types distinct.

## Validation

`NonFinitePlistTests.swift` covers Foundation XML/binary roundtrips with nested NaNs, document equality, authenticated export/verify, altered outer payloads, unrelated device edits, and rollback when readback changes NaN to infinity.

[Upstream reproduction](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42782626446). Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed in [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428), job `compare-nan-plist-values`, and [combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: reject device identity changes before system writes
body:
## Problem

The field editor can alter or remove the identifiers used to bind saved original values and backups. An accepted edit can make the next device read reject the app's own journal as belonging to another device.

## Change

Before device access, compare the presence, plist type, and exact value of UDID, serial-number, and ECID fields, including their named aliases and hashed keys. Device commits and restores reject identifier changes. Local documents remain editable.

## Validation

`DeviceIdentityEditTests.swift` covers all six keys, removal, addition, value/type changes, representation changes, normal edits and reopen, local edits, and zero access/backup/journal/write side effects on rejection. The error is maintained in all localization sources.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch and combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291), job `preserve-device-identity-fields`.

title: fix: stop complete journals from rereading old backup history
body:
## Problem

A journal without an audio or WAPI entry scans historical backups on every device read and commit. That absence is normal when a flag was never changed, so a corrupt old backup can block access even when the journal is complete. Missing both entries also scans the same history twice.

## Change

Persist completion of cache-history migration. Older v1 journals recover both optional entries in one pass, including a durable completion marker when neither flag has history. Current journals then treat absent entries as unchanged flags.

## Validation

`OriginalHistoryMigrationTests.swift` verifies actual actor backup-read attempts, one-pass legacy migration, durable empty-history completion, and successful device reads/writes after truncating an old backup. Existing legacy fixtures explicitly omit the new marker.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428), job `complete-original-history-migration`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: recover cache originals from matching system generations
body:
## Problem

Saved FaceTime Audio or WAPI originals can remain tied to an earlier CacheUUID after a system update. Later edits keep that incompatible record, and history reconstruction can chain backups from different generations.

## Change

Recover incompatible cache originals from the earliest owned pre-write backup matching the current CacheUUID, CacheVersion, and CacheData length. Archive the previous journal before migration. If no original can be established, keep the affected restoration unavailable while allowing other edits. Remember every previously unknown layout so later backups cannot become false original baselines after switching away and back.

## Validation

`OriginalCacheGenerationTests.swift` covers matching recovery, older UUID/build rejection, exact journal preservation, missing-journal recovery, repeated edits with unavailable history, legacy marker decoding, and returning to an unknown layout. New messages are maintained in all localization sources.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch and combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291), job `scope-originals-to-cache-generation`.

title: fix: clear inherited device ownership when restoring a local backup
body:
## Problem

Restoring a backup while a verified local import is open carries the previous document's ownership flag onto the replacement payload. An unrelated local backup can then appear eligible for device restoration and authenticated export.

## Change

Clear inherited ownership whenever a backup replaces a local document. Ordinary edits to a verified import retain its provenance, and edits to an unverified replacement cannot regain it.

## Validation

`LocalRestoreProvenanceTests.swift` uses real temporary local/device files to cover normal edits, replacement by a foreign backup, rejection by verified restoration, subsequent edits, and preservation of device bytes.

Native tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed: [branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783243933), job `reset-restored-local-provenance`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: capture direct file imports before deferring confirmation
body:
## Problem

`onOpenURL` discards direct file URLs while welcome, an existing confirmation, or another presentation gate is active. A prepared offer is also lost if a gate changes during verification. The sender may no longer provide that URL on retry.

## Change

Acquire security-scoped access immediately and copy on a background task into a private durable inbox. Use the existing verification and confirmation queue after gates clear. Preserve the current offer and later incoming files, forward cancellation to coordination, and defer automatic device reading while capture is in progress.

## Validation

- `DirectFileImportTests.swift` covers closed presentation gates, removal of the source URL, reopening the queue, later incoming files, and invalid input.
- Native Swift tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed.

[Branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428), job `defer-direct-file-imports`. [Combined validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: clean up temporary exports after sharing or cancellation
body:
## Problem

Each export creates a UUID directory, but sharing completion, cancellation, and failed creation leave those files behind. Repeated large exports accumulate temporary copies.

## Change

Represent each export as an owned artifact in a dedicated directory. Clean it up after completion or dismissal and after failed creation. Keep active exports independent, and preserve the current share when another export is requested.

## Validation

- `TemporaryExportTests.swift` checks file lifetime, independent active exports, repeat cleanup, unrelated files, and creation/write failures.
- Native Swift tests and the iOS simulator app/share-extension build passed.

[Branch validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783243933), job `clean-up-export-artifacts`. [Combined regression validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42785214291).

title: fix: attach device proof to exports of owned device backups

## Problem

## Problem

The scanner skips out-of-range indices and unknown query types before checking required target keys. A valid descriptor can therefore hide a malformed duplicate for green-tea or not-green-tea.

## Change

title: fix: preserve App Group cache contents during device access
body:
## Problem

Device access replaces the App Group's `Library/Caches` item with a temporary link. The existing setup and cleanup delete that item recursively, so a successful query or a rejected query can erase cache data already stored in the group.

## Changes

- Move the original cache item to a unique sibling before installing the temporary link, then restore that same item when the query finishes.
- Restore the original after setup failures and unsuccessful query results as well as successful access.
- Check the temporary link's device and inode before removing it. If another process has replaced the path, preserve its replacement and the saved original, report the restoration failure, and release any acquired handle.

## Validation

- Native Foundation filesystem tests cover nested contents, original inode preservation, successful and rejected queries, a missing cache directory, dangling links, failed link creation, and a concurrent path replacement.
- The target directory's sentinel remains unchanged throughout the tests.
- iOS simulator app and share-extension build passed.

[Native tests and build](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42783979428) (`preserve-app-group-caches`, commit `c2af7e56f4298a2c389c7e1692ca73c681f83320`).

title: fix: fall back across signed App Groups when device access is denied
body:
Fixes #29

## 问题

同一张证书（LCSign + 个人 P12 / 描述文件，签名带 5 个 App Group）、同一台 iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 27.0.1 上，v1.0.2 可以连接设备，v1.0.3 启动即报：

> MobileGestalt 访问被拒绝，请检查系统版本与 App Group 签名。

这条文案对应的不是「没有 App Group」（那种情况抛的是 `The signed app has no usable App Group`），而是 `worse_query()` 返回了 `-1` 之外的负值。两个版本的 `worse_query.m` 与调用参数完全相同，唯一影响该路径的差异是选组方式：

- v1.0.2：按签名中的顺序取第一个可用组（本机为 `.5`，可用）；
- v1.0.3：`usableAppGroups()` 改为优先 bundle 组，其余按字母排序取第一个（本机为 `.1`，不可用）。

另外这个失败是不可自愈的：`worse_query()` 会把组容器的 `Library/Caches` 换成软链，失败路径里 `removeItemAtPath` 的错误被忽略，若容器缺 `Library` 目录就会一直停在 `-4`。

## 改动

只动 `GestaltX/GestaltManager.swift` 的 acquire 闭包（+21 −7）：

1. 遍历 `GXEntitlementsReader.usableAppGroups()`，逐个调用 `worse_query()`，`handle >= 0` 立即返回；
2. 遇到 `-4`（建软链失败）时，先补建该组的 `Library/Caches` 再重试一次；
3. 全部失败才抛原来的报错，`-1` 仍映射为「没有可用 App Group」。

单组证书时行为与原来完全一致（只有一个候选，等价于原逻辑）；多组证书不再依赖排序结果。

## 验证

- 同一台 iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 27.0.1、LCSign + 同一张 P12（5 个 App Group）：官方 v1.0.3 重签后启动即报错；应用本补丁后的构建可正常连接设备、读取 MobileGestalt 并应用预设。
- rebase 到当前 `main` 后用仓库自带的 `.github/workflows/build.yml` 构建通过：https://github.com/cutemaoqiu/GestaltX/actions/runs/42765868689

## 备注

- 更彻底的做法是把「上次成功的组」持久化，避免每次启动都重试前几个坏组；但那会引入额外状态，先不放进这个补丁。
- 顺带一句：当前 release 的 `GestaltX_1.0.3.ipa` 仍是完全未签名、无 entitlements 的（见 #21），`main` 上的 `build-ipa.sh` 已经修好但还没发版。这与本 PR 无关，只是提醒下个版本发布时才会生效。

title: fix: drain shared imports after rejection and confirmation
body:
## Problem

The import check considers one oldest entry. Rejecting it, or accepting/cancelling its confirmation, can leave later files waiting until another foreground event. An all-invalid queue can also prevent initial device reading from resuming.

## Change

Process a finite, ordered inbox snapshot and distinguish ready, rejected and deferred entries. Skip permanent rejections, retain temporary verification failures for a later retry and continue after a confirmation is dismissed. Resume initial reading when the queue empties.

Use one presentation gate for existing modals, busy state and staged changes, and recheck it after asynchronous verification. Preserve an already displayed offer when another file URL arrives. A captured entry is visited at most once per pass, including when quarantine fails or new files arrive during verification.

## Validation

- `SharedImportQueueTests` uses temporary inboxes to cover invalid-to-valid draining, successive cancellation/acceptance, all-invalid fallback, deferred retention and a growing queue with failed quarantine.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42752087045/job/129617813979).

title: fix: coordinate plist imports with file providers
body:
## Problem

A security-scoped URL grants access but does not coordinate a read with its File Provider. `readDocument` reads the original URL directly, without giving the provider a coordinated access window or using the URL supplied by its accessor.

## Change

Perform the bounded, validated read inside `NSFileCoordinator` while the security scope is active. Read the accessor's URL and propagate coordination errors instead of falling back to an uncoordinated read. Reject known nonregular paths before coordination, since coordination itself can block on a FIFO. Missing placeholders remain eligible for provider materialization. Item-provider temporary-file reads remain inside their callback lifetime.

## Validation

- `CoordinatedPlistReadTests` uses controlled redirecting/failing coordinators and a real local-file coordinated read.
- Cases cover an unavailable original placeholder, error propagation, invalid plist data and the existing size limit. Real FIFO, directory and symlink fixtures verify rejection before entering coordination; the default coordinator is also checked with a FIFO.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42752087045/job/129617814352).

title: fix: preserve malformed artwork values during preset edits
body:
## Problem

The artwork getter falls back to an empty dictionary for a non-dictionary value. Model-name and Dynamic Island layout presets then replace that existing value, silently losing its contents and updating companion fields as though the artwork edit succeeded.

## Change

Have `setArtwork` refuse an existing non-dictionary value and report success explicitly. Update companion fields only after success, and reject a stale invalid preset selection before applying changes. Disable the affected controls with a specific explanation, translated into all eight supported languages.

Missing artwork can still be created, and valid dictionaries retain unknown keys and value types.

## Validation

- `ArtworkPreservationTests` checks 28 rejected edits across seven non-dictionary types, two preset fields and XML/binary inputs. Missing/empty dictionaries and unknown-key preservation provide successful controls.
- Localization generation is deterministic and includes the new explanation in all eight locales.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42751158319/job/129614838510).

title: fix: preserve staged edits when opening or restoring backups
body:
## Problem

Opening or restoring a backup replaces the current document and clears its staged edits. Both manager methods currently check only whether an operation is busy, so selecting a backup can discard pending work without an explicit save or discard.

## Change

Require zero pending changes before either manager entry point accesses the file store. Preserve the existing busy guard and show the established save-or-discard message when the operation is refused.

Disable Open, Restore and the restore-confirmation action while edits are pending. Show the same message in the Backups view so the user can resolve the pending edits before continuing.

## Validation

- The reused message is present in all eight supported locales.
- The existing native Swift regression executables and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed on macOS (`xcode-27`) in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609395185).

title: fix: cancel pending share-extension provider loads
body:
## Problem

Cancelling the share task does not resume a suspended provider continuation when the provider never calls back. The returned `Progress` is discarded, and callbacks arriving after cancellation can still try to read temporary files or update the extension UI.

## Change

Add a small synchronized callback bridge that completes each continuation once, cancels retained provider progress and ignores callbacks arriving after completion or cancellation. Handle cancellation before startup and before the provider returns its progress object. Keep temporary-file reads inside the provider callback and suppress a late app-opening UI completion after cancellation.

## Validation

- `ItemProviderLoadTests` drives immediate success, errors, duplicate callbacks, stalled providers, cancellation at different startup points and callbacks invoked synchronously by `Progress.cancel()`.
- Late callbacks are checked for continued task completion and for not invoking the read closure.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609395096).

title: fix: avoid blocking shared imports on nonregular files
body:
## Problem

Opening inbox metadata through `FileHandle(forReadingFrom:)` can wait indefinitely when the path is a named pipe with no writer. Metadata reads can also follow a symlink before validating their contents.

## Change

Open bounded-read inputs with nonblocking, no-follow and close-on-exec flags. Check the opened descriptor with `fstat` and accept only regular files before reading any bytes. Keep the existing size limits and plist validation.

## Validation

- `SharedPlistInboxTests` now exercises symlinked metadata, a metadata FIFO with no writer, a document FIFO and a directory input.
- Restoring the regular metadata file confirms that ordinary inbox reads still work after rejected entries.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609395214).

title: fix: preserve exact values in unchanged field edits
body:
## Problem

Opening a field and staging it without changing its text reparses the display representation. Date formatting can lose binary plist precision, including dates nested inside XML array/dictionary text. Renaming a key can therefore change its value unintentionally.

## Change

Capture the original value and initial text in `FieldDraft`. Reuse that exact value when the type and text are unchanged, including a key-only rename. Changed text, explicit type changes and new fields continue through normal parsing. Display fractional seconds when editing a Date.

## Validation

- `FieldValuePrecisionTests` covers sub-millisecond and near-epoch dates, nested date collections, key renames, binary serialization, changed values, explicit type changes and new drafts.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42751158319/job/129614838451).

title: fix: verify saved backup contents before reuse
body:
## Problem

Reading a saved backup currently verifies only that it parses as a MobileGestalt plist. Its recorded byte count is ignored, and replacing it with a different valid plist can go unnoticed before opening, exporting or restoring it.

## Change

Store a SHA-256 digest in new backup records. Check the recorded length and, when present, the digest whenever `backupData` loads the file. Preserve compatibility with older metadata: records without a digest still undergo length and plist validation.

## Validation

- `BackupIntegrityTests` checks an unchanged backup, a different valid plist of identical size, truncation, an incorrect digest and decoding the actual older metadata schema.
- The fixtures verify that rejected backup reads leave the device-path file unchanged.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609394791).

title: fix: reject incompatible device backup layouts
body:
## Problem

A backup from the same device can contain an older system cache layout. The backup restore path checks ownership but does not check its layout before passing the complete document to the device writer.

## Change

Share a layout validator between saved-backup restoration and verified imports. Require a matching nonempty `CacheUUID`, matching `CacheData` lengths and matching `CacheVersion` values with their plist types. Both documents may omit `CacheVersion`.

Reject incompatible device restores before writer, backup and journal side effects. Older layouts remain available for opening as local documents.

## Validation

- `BackupLayoutTests` uses temporary files and a counted writer to cover UUID/version mismatches, missing metadata, invalid data types and different data lengths. Matching-layout restores and local-document access provide successful controls.
- The existing document fixture now includes explicit layout metadata.
- Native Swift regression execution on macOS (`xcode-27`) and the iOS Simulator build of the app and embedded share extension passed in [CI](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609395296).

title: Preserve full 64-bit integer values when editing and verifying plists
body:
Integer editing currently rejects plist values above Int64.max even though binary property lists can represent the full UInt64 range. The read-back comparison also truncates NSNumber values through int64Value, so UInt64.max can compare equal to -1.

This change parses the signed and unsigned 64-bit ranges explicitly and compares integer values by their full decimal representations. It preserves the existing Boolean and floating-point handling.

Validation:
- Added boundary, nested comparison, binary round-trip, and write-verification rollback cases in IntegerValueTests.swift.
- All regression executables pass on the xcode-27 macOS runner.
- The app and Share Extension build for the iOS simulator with signing disabled.
- [Validation job](https://github.com/Afloat16/GestaltX/actions/runs/42749468547/job/129609395152).

Device cache writes were tested through the existing test writer; no physical-device write is claimed.

title: [Bug Report] v1.0.2 可用、v1.0.3 报「MobileGestalt 访问被拒绝」：证书 App Group 正常（LCSign 签名），疑似选组逻辑变更
body:
## 环境

- 设备：iPhone 16 Pro
- 系统：iOS 27.0.1（App 内显示「支持」）
- GestaltX：v1.0.3（官方 release IPA，用 **LCSign** + 个人 P12 / 描述文件重签）
- 注：`GXEntitlementsReader` 的注释写明「来源：LCSign 的 LCEntitlementsReader」，所以这就是该 reader 主要适配的那条签名路径
- 证书 entitlements 含 `com.apple.security.application-groups`，共 5 个组（`group.<hex>.1` ~ `.5`，签名中的顺序为 .5 / .3 / .2 / .1 / .4，为免泄露签名账号信息已隐去完整 ID）
- 主 App 与 `GestaltXShare.appex` 签入同一批 App Group

## 现象

启动即弹：

> MobileGestalt 访问被拒绝，请检查系统版本与 App Group 签名。

设备状态回到「本地文件」，无法读取本机 MobileGestalt。**同一张证书、同一台设备、同一签名方式，重签 v1.0.2 可以正常连接设备**，所以排除「证书没有 App Group」这一类原因。

## 定位到源码的部分

这条文案来自 `GestaltManager.swift` 的 acquire 闭包：

```swift
guard let signedGroup = GXEntitlementsReader.usableAppGroup() else {
    throw GestaltFailure("The signed app has no usable App Group. ...")   // ← 未触发
}
let handle = worse_query((GestaltKeys.devicePath as NSString).deletingLastPathComponent,
                         signedGroup, false, false)
guard handle >= 0 else {
    if handle == -1 { throw GestaltFailure("The signed app has no usable App Group. ...") }
    throw GestaltFailure("MobileGestalt access was denied. ...")           // ← 触发的是这条
}
```

https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/v1.0.3/GestaltX/GestaltManager.swift#L50-L57

也就是说：`usableAppGroup()` 返回了非 nil、组容器可解析，失败发生在 `worse_query()` 内部（`-2 / -3 / -4 / -5 / -6 / -255` 之一）。

再对比两个版本：

- `worse_query.m` 与调用参数在 v1.0.2 → v1.0.3 之间 `git diff` 为空，逃逸逻辑逐字节一致；
- 唯一影响这条路径的改动是 `GXEntitlementsReader.m` 的选组逻辑：v1.0.2 按签名中的顺序取第一个可用组；v1.0.3 改为优先 `group.<bundleIdentifier>` / `group.com.huami.gestultx`，其余按**字母排序**取第一个。

https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/v1.0.3/GestaltX/GXEntitlementsReader.m#L116-L152

在我的证书（5 个组）下，v1.0.2 实际用的是 `.5`，v1.0.3 会选 `.1`。因此「v1.0.2 正常、v1.0.3 报错」最可能是**换用了另一个 App Group**，而那个组的容器状态不可用（例如 `Library` 目录尚未建立 → 建 `Library/Caches` 软链 ENOENT → `return -4`；或该组未被 containermanagerd 认账 → `-5`）。

待补：操作日志（工具 → 日志 → 操作日志）里 `[worse_query] Begin: target=… group=…` 与 `End: return=-N` 的返回值，拿到后我会在这里补上确切码。

## 建议

1. **acquire 阶段遍历 `usableAppGroups()` 逐个尝试**，`handle >= 0` 即用该组。多组证书（签名服务自动生成的组很常见）下更稳，也能顺带规避容器状态不一致。
2. `-4`（建软链失败）时先补建 `Library/Caches` 再重试一次，避免组容器不完整时永久失败。
3. 候选排序保留「签名原始顺序」作为主依据，避免升级后选组行为漂移；或把实际选中的组写进日志，方便用户自查。

## 附带（非本 bug，供参考）

当前 release 的 `GestaltX_1.0.3.ipa` 仍是完全未签名、无 entitlements 的：

```bash
$ codesign -dv --entitlements - Payload/GestaltX.app
Payload/GestaltX.app: code object is not signed at all
```

与 #21 描述一致。README 里「发布的 IPA 使用 ad-hoc 签名嵌入这些 entitlements」应只存在于尚未发版的分支提交中，因此 SideStore / AltStore 目前仍无法据此自动识别 App Group，实际只能依赖证书自带的组。

如需截图（报错弹窗 + 证书 entitlements 页）我可以补充。

title: [Bug Report] Release IPA 未签名、缺少 entitlements，AltStore / SideStore 重签后无法获得 App Group，导致无法修改 MobileGestalt
body:
## 问题

Release 中的 `GestaltX_1.0.3.ipa` 是完全未签名的，主 App 和 Share Extension 都不带任何 entitlements：

```bash
$ codesign -d --entitlements - --xml Payload/GestaltX.app
Payload/GestaltX.app: code object is not signed at all

$ codesign -d --entitlements - --xml Payload/GestaltX.app/PlugIns/GestaltXShare.appex
Payload/GestaltX.app/PlugIns/GestaltXShare.appex: code object is not signed at all
```

AltStore / SideStore 重签时，是从 IPA 现有的签名里读取 entitlements，再据此在开发者账号下注册 App Group。IPA 没签名，它们就看不到 `com.apple.security.application-groups`，也就不会注册 App Group。安装后 GestaltX 拿不到 App Group container，无法修改本机的 MobileGestalt。

#6, #13 里遇到的应该也是这个问题。有用户反馈换成 iloader 签名后可以正常使用，可能是因为它注册 App Group 的方式不同。

## 复现

1. 下载 Release 中的 `GestaltX_1.0.3.ipa`
2. 用 AltStore 或 SideStore 安装
3. 打开 GestaltX 尝试修改任意项，失败，提示需要可用的 App Group

## 建议的修复

打包 IPA 前，用 ad-hoc 签名把仓库里已有的 entitlements 嵌进去，按从内到外的顺序：

```bash
app=Payload/GestaltX.app
appex="$app/PlugIns/GestaltXShare.appex"

# 先签内部的 framework / dylib
find "$app" \( -name '*.framework' -o -name '*.dylib' \) -exec codesign -f -s - {} \;

# 再签 extension，最后签主 App
codesign -f -s - --entitlements ShareExtension/GestaltXShare.entitlements "$appex"
codesign -f -s - --entitlements GestaltX/GestaltX.entitlements "$app"
```

ad-hoc 签名不需要证书，可以直接在 CI 里跑。重签工具会用自己的证书覆盖这个签名，但会保留 entitlements，并据此注册 `group.com.huami.gestultx`。

title: Add Canada region preset and a Model Number preset picker
body:
## What this adds

**1. Canada in `RegionPreset`**

```swift
.init(id: "CA", title: "Canada", code: "C", info: "C/A")
```

It sits next to the existing five regions, so it works from both the Region Code and the Sales Region pickers.

**2. A `ModelPreset` picker for the `ModelNumber` field** (`97JDvERpVwO+GHtthIh7hA`)

Region-only edits leave the model number in Settings → General → About untouched, and several community workflows change both fields. This exposes the model number as an explicit, labelled choice instead of a manual `CacheExtra` edit:

| | United States | Canada / Japan | Other regions | China mainland |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| iPhone 18 Pro | A3472 | A3713 | A3714 | A3715 |
| iPhone 18 Pro Max | A3473 | A3716 | A3717 | A3718 |

Values are taken from Apple's "Identify your iPhone model" article (<https://support.apple.com/108044>).

## Design notes

- Model Number is a **separate picker** rather than being folded into `RegionPreset`: region code and model number are independent fields, and the README already recommends changing only the region code in most cases.
- The section footer warns that the listed values are valid only for the two named models, and that a model number which does not match the hardware makes verification tools report a mismatch.
- `applyModel` writes nothing when "Keep Current" is selected, so staged edits elsewhere are left alone.
- Both new types follow the existing shape (`Identifiable` preset list + picker bound through `GestaltManager`), so no new state machinery is introduced.

## Deliberately not included

- **Localization.** The new labels fall back to their English keys. `GestaltX/Localizable.xcstrings` was left untouched on purpose: Xcode re-serializes the whole catalog on build, which would bury a 36-line change in a ~19k-line diff. If you would rather have entries in `localization/*.json` for `scripts/generate_localization.py` to pick up, I can add those instead.
- **Other device models.** I did not guess model numbers for devices I could not verify against Apple's page (including iPhone Duo, `iPhone19,4`). The picker is intentionally limited rather than wrong.

## Testing

- Built, signed and launched on iOS / iPadOS 27.2 on an iPhone 18 Pro (`iPhone19,2`) and an iPhone Duo (`iPhone19,4`).
- Confirmed all eight values are present in the compiled binary and that the picker renders in the Intelligence category.
- **Not exercised:** the actual MobileGestalt write for the new field. The write path is the same `set(_:for:)` call used by the region presets, but I would treat it as untested until someone applies it on a device.

Happy to restructure this if you would prefer the model presets to live behind a caution flag, or gated on the detected `ProductType`.

title: iOS 27.0 (24A437): MobileGestalt readable but O_RDWR denied (EPERM) inside LiveContainer
body:
## Environment

- **Device:** iPhone 13 (iPhone14,5)
- **iOS:** 27.0 public release (24A437)
- **GestaltX:** v1.0.2 with local diagnostic patches
- **Installation:** LiveContainer with free Apple ID signing
- **App Groups:** Accessible signed App Group detected successfully

## Problem

GestaltX successfully obtains and consumes a ContainerManager sandbox extension, reads the MobileGestalt cache, and creates a verified backup.

However, attempting to open `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist` with `O_RDWR` consistently returns:

`errno=1 (Operation not permitted)`

An initial attempt to apply the Apple Intelligence Capability preset failed with a write-verification error. After discarding staged changes and re-reading the cache, the capability key was still absent.

All subsequent diagnostic tests were non-destructive.

## Diagnostic Results (V3–V6)

| Method | Result |
|---|---|
| Class 7, flags `0x8000000000` | Token received, write denied |
| Class 7, flags `0x8100000000` | Token received, write denied |
| Class 7, temporary symlink path | Read permitted, write denied |
| Class 13, direct | Container result, no sandbox token |
| Class 13, `/var` traversal | No container result |
| Class 13, `/private/var` traversal | No container result |

### File Permissions

```text
mode=0644
uid=501
gid=4294967294
flags=0x00000000
process_euid=501
process_egid=501
size=10765 bytes
```

The temporary App Group symlink was verified to reference the same device/inode as the original MobileGestalt file.

### Relevant Logs

```text
Query configured: class=7 part=3 flags=0x0000008100000000
Sandbox token received (contents omitted); consuming extension
Extension consumed: handle=3

[LC DIAG v3] open(O_RDWR) DENIED: errno=1 (Operation not permitted); NO WRITE ATTEMPTED

[LC DIAG v5] ALIAS VERIFIED: device/inode match, size=10765
[LC DIAG v5] alias open(O_RDONLY) PERMITTED; FD closed; NO WRITE ATTEMPTED
[LC DIAG v5] alias open(O_RDWR) DENIED: errno=1 (Operation not permitted); NO WRITE ATTEMPTED

[LC DIAG v6] class13-direct: result=YES token=NO consume=-5
[LC DIAG v6] class13-file-var: result=NO token=NO consume=-5
[LC DIAG v6] class13-file-private: result=NO token=NO consume=-5

Original Caches directory restored (contents preserved)
Read: 10765 bytes; validating plist
Backup: 10765 bytes saved and verified
```

## LiveContainer Compatibility Modifications

The original GestaltX symlink implementation encountered problems inside LiveContainer.

I tested a locally patched implementation that:

- Uses POSIX `symlink()` instead of Foundation's symlink method.
- Temporarily backs up the existing App Group `Library/Caches` directory.
- Restores the original directory after obtaining the sandbox extension.
- Preserves the original MobileGestalt contents.
- Adds read-only permission diagnostics and a Copy All Logs button.

These modifications are not part of the official GestaltX release.

The patches successfully resolved MobileGestalt **read access**, but write access remains denied.

## Questions

1. Is MobileGestalt write access expected to work on public iOS 27.0 (24A437) when running GestaltX inside LiveContainer?
2. Could LiveContainer's host-app entitlements explain why the sandbox extension is successfully consumed but `O_RDWR` returns `EPERM`?
3. Is there another non-destructive way to determine whether the issued sandbox extension is read-only?
4. Does GestaltX require standalone installation rather than LiveContainer to obtain write access?

## Additional Information

- MobileGestalt plist size: 10,765 bytes
- CacheExtra: 80 keys
- Device identification and cache parsing work correctly.
- No MobileGestalt modifications were attempted during V3–V6.
- Original App Group Caches directory was successfully restored after each diagnostic test.
- Sandbox token contents and personal App Group identifiers have been omitted.

**Related issue:** #15

Any guidance on whether this is an iOS 27.0 restriction, LiveContainer limitation, or a problem with the sandbox extension would be appreciated.

title: 什么时候能支持iOS26.6.2
在打包ipa时候略做调整，以便支持AltStore的AppGroup写入
body:
因为AltStore会修改（增加开发者标识）应用的ID，因此问了ChatGPT，解释如下。


-----

**最小方案只有一处：在压缩生成 IPA 之前，加一条 `codesign` 命令。** 前面新增整套构建脚本、检查器和 Scheme 的方案偏重了，这些都不是修复这个问题的必要条件。

## 最小修改

假设在项目根目录执行，待打包的应用已经放在 `Payload/GestaltX.app`：

```bash
codesign --force --sign - --entitlements GestaltX/GestaltX.entitlements --generate-entitlement-der "Payload/GestaltX.app"
```

**把这条命令加入发布者原本的打包过程，位置是：**

1. Xcode 构建出 `.app`。
2. **执行上述命令。**
3. 将 `Payload` 压缩为 IPA，发布。

如果 `.app` 在其他目录，只需要替换命令最后的路径。

这条命令会把项目已有的 App Groups 声明写入临时签名，之后 AltStore 就能识别它，并为用户的账号申请相应权限、完成正式签名。**发布者执行这一步不需要 Apple 开发者证书。**

## 为什么只加这一条就够了？

这个项目已经具备两部分：

- [`[GestaltX.entitlements](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/53d45ce7ce6c75bf72ee646427fcc0a05f0405b2/GestaltX/GestaltX.entitlements)`](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/53d45ce7ce6c75bf72ee646427fcc0a05f0405b2/GestaltX/GestaltX.entitlements) 已声明 App Group。
- [`[GXEntitlementsReader.m](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/53d45ce7ce6c75bf72ee646427fcc0a05f0405b2/GestaltX/GXEntitlementsReader.m)`](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/53d45ce7ce6c75bf72ee646427fcc0a05f0405b2/GestaltX/GXEntitlementsReader.m) 已支持读取重签后的实际组名。

**缺的只是“把声明写进发布产物的签名”这一动作。** 你给我的原始 IPA 完全没有代码签名，因此 AltStore 读不到这项声明。

## 如果你要求“只改一行 Swift 或 Info.plist”呢？

**这无法解决当前这个未签名 IPA 的问题。** AltStore 在应用运行前就要读取权限声明，修改应用启动后的 Swift 逻辑介入不了这个阶段；往 `Info.plist` 加字段也不等于签名中有权限。

所以，对当前 GestaltX，最小且直接的调整就是：**保留现有应用代码，在作者的发布打包步骤中增加上面这一条预签命令。** 以后发布出来的 IPA，用户直接导入 AltStore 即可，不用再自行处理。

title: 添加 FaceTime Audio 预设（iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 27.3 beta 1）
body:
为国行 iPhone 17 Pro 添加 FaceTime Audio 预设，通过修改 MobileGestalt `CacheData` 中的 `green-tea` 和 `not-green-tea` 两个布尔标记，解除对应的地区能力限制。

支持 **iPhone 17 Pro（iPhone18,1）/ iOS 27.3 beta 1（24C5037i）**。

## 改动

- 在“设备 → 预设”中新增 FaceTime Audio，支持启用和恢复限制。
- 修改 CacheData 中的两个标记，并在“查看更改”中显示前后值。

## 验证

- 已在上述国行实机上确认 FaceTime Audio 可用。
- 自动测试、模拟器界面验证及 iOS 构建通过。

## 来源

思路来自 [KirbySD 的 V2EX 帖子](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1246550)，本构建的偏移由匹配系统库分析得出。
